postings.conferenceName: International Alzheimer’s Disease, Dementia & Cognitive Disorders Conference (ADDC 2027)
postings.conferenceSeries: Alzheimer’s Disease, Dementia & Cognitive Disorders Conference (ADDC 2027)
postings.conferenceText: In its 3rd edition, the 3rd Edition of International Alzheimer's Disease, Dementia & Cognitive Disorders Conference (ADDC 2027) settles at NH Villa Carpegna in Rome from June 24-26, 2027, alongside a virtual channel that opens the meeting to attendees anywhere in the world. Organised by Magnus Group LLC, the Dementia Conference 2027 brings clinicians, neuroscientists, geriatricians, cognitive-disorder specialists, policy advocates, academic researchers, and pharmaceutical innovators into three days of scholarly programme, clinical exchange, and interdisciplinary conversation across Alzheimer's disease, dementia, and cognitive-disorder research. Programme content covers diagnosis and early signs of disease, biomarkers for Alzheimer's and dementia, treatment strategies, cognitive decline and impairment, psychogeriatrics, depression and psychotic symptoms, geriatrics and healthy ageing, immunotherapy and stem-cell approaches, genetics in Alzheimer's and dementia, social and behavioural investigations, the relationship between inflammation and neurodegeneration, and current updates in Alzheimer's and dementia - designed to bring diagnostic, therapeutic, and policy perspectives into a single, coherent conversation. Clinicians, researchers, and geriatric-medicine specialists are warmly invited to contribute original findings, clinical case work, and topical reviews for oral or poster presentation. Delegates and listeners may complete registration on the International Alzheimer's Conference 2027 portal, joining either on-site at NH Villa Carpegna or remotely from any country - both routes are equally supported by the hybrid format. postings.conferenceName: From Innovation to Global Market: Biopharma Going Global 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The Congress of Biopharma Industry Development
postings.conferenceText: The congress aims to bring together global leaders from academia, industry, and investment communities to exchange insights, share best practices, and explore emerging opportunities across the biopharmaceutical value chain. In addition to keynote lectures and thematic sessions, the program will include high-level panel discussions, industry exhibitions, project matchmaking opportunities, and a curated visit to a leading biopharmaceutical park in Shanghai, offering firsthand exposure to China’s innovation ecosystem. As one of Asia’s leading hubs for biopharmaceutical innovation, Shanghai offers a dynamic environment shaped by progressive policies, strong R&D capabilities, and active global collaboration. Under the theme “Integrating Global Vision, Driving Industrial Innovation,” the congress is designed not only as a platform for academic exchange, but also as a catalyst for meaningful collaboration and long-term partnerships. postings.conferenceSeries: 2nd Edition of International Conference on Clinical Immunology, Allergy & Autoimmune Diseases
postings.conferenceText: Conference: 2nd Edition of International Conference on Clinical Immunology, Allergy & Autoimmune Diseases (ICIAA 2027) Venue: NH Villa Carpegna, Rome, Italy Dates: June 28-30, 2027 Mode: Hybrid (Onsite + Virtual) Catalogued as the Immunology Summit 2027 across immunology directories, this meeting supports evidence-led dialogue on clinical immunology, allergy, and autoimmune disease - encouraging journal publication, cross-continental collaboration, and industry-academia connection. The Immunology Symposium 2027 reviews submissions from clinical immunologists, allergy researchers, autoimmune-disease specialists, and biotech and vaccine-industry professionals; contributions accepted for review appear in oral or poster sessions with strong indexing visibility. Multi-perspective in outlook, the programme brings together voices from academic immunology, hospital allergy and immunology units, biotech and vaccine industry, and diagnostic laboratories. Sessions surface progress in immunodermatology, diagnostic immunology, immunogenetics, and autoimmune-disease research - giving attendees a clear view of the field's current priorities. Rome brings the meeting to a central European junction, while the concurrent virtual stream extends it to colleagues in every region. postings.conferenceName: 11th Edition of World Congress on Infectious Diseases 2027
postings.conferenceText: Rome and Online, June 28-30, 2027 - the 11th Edition of World Congress on Infectious Diseases hosts the international infectious-disease community for three days of scholarly programme. Compiled as a CPD-accredited three-day meeting at NH Villa Carpegna, Rome (June 28-30, 2027), the 11th Edition of World Congress on Infectious Diseases (Infection 2027) gives the international infectious-disease and clinical-microbiology community a working forum for scholarly briefings, clinical sessions, and case-based discussion. Every session is directed at moving research into practice for clinicians, microbiologists, and public-health specialists. Coverage at this Vaccines Conference 2027 reaches across COVID-19 and post-pandemic research, blood infections and sepsis, immunity and inflammation, viral infections, paediatric infectious diseases, antimicrobial resistance, vaccines and virology, ageing-related infectious diseases, public-health response, drug discovery, bacterial, fungal, and parasitic infections, and clinical pharmacology. Delegates and presenters who attend the meeting are given a CPD certificate of attendance; oral or poster abstracts that pass review add further academic recognition. Within the Infectious Diseases Conferences 2027 calendar, this meeting operates a tiered registration model - abstract submission for speakers and presenters, standard or early-bird rates for delegates and listeners.
